    Deliberately unknown ids used for 404 checks are fine.

componentResults.reason: I read src/payments.test.ts and src/mocks/handlers.ts. (a) Isolation holds. afterEach calls both server.resetHandlers() and resetPayments(), so the module-level Map is cleared after every test. Every state-dependent test (get, list, filter, refund, cancel) creates its own payments through newPayment(). List assertions compare against the ids the test just created, and the empty-list test runs against a cleared store, so no test depends on leftovers or on run order. (b) No test uses tok_timeout, a sleep, or a custom timeout. The only tokens used are tok_visa, tok_pending, tok_unknown, tok_chargeDeclined, tok_insufficientFunds and tok_serverError. (c) Every id used in a happy path or state check comes from the server response (created.id, a.id, b.id). The hardcoded ids 'pay_missing' and 'pay_any' appear only in 404 checks and in 401 checks. In the 401 cases the handler rejects the request before any lookup, so the id has no effect. All three conditions hold.
